items.title: A Quiet Night in Edo Japan | Calm History for Sleep (Lanterns, River & Temple Bells, 47 Min)
items.description:
Spend one slow autumn night in old Edo, the city that would become Tokyo. Hear the temple bells count the hours from the wooden Nihonbashi bridge, drift down the Sumida in a lantern-lit boat, walk the merchant lanes as the shop curtains come in, soak in the neighbourhood bathhouse, and listen to the night watchman's wooden clappers as the city falls asleep.

Slow narration, soft ambient sound and a long quiet tail at the end, so you can let go whenever you are ready.
